text: A block is pulled for a distance of 50 m along a horizontal floor, by a rope that is inclined at an angle
of α to the floor. The tension in the rope is 180 N and the work done by the tension is 8200 J. Find
the value of α. [3]
A car of mass 1250 kg is travelling along a straight horizontal road with its engine working at a
constant rate of P W. The resistance to the car’s motion is constant and equal to R N. When the
speed of the car is 19 m s its acceleration is 0.6 m s , and when the speed of the car is 30 m s its
acceleration is 0.16 m s . Find the values of P and R. [6]

A lorry of mass 15 000 kg climbs a hill of length 500 m at a constant speed. The hill is inclined at
2.5 to the horizontal. The resistance to the lorry’s motion is constant and equal to 800 N.
